title: Borel complexity of isometry classes of $\mathcal{C}(K)$ spaces with countable compacta
summary: For every countable compact space $K$, we determine the exact Borel complexity of the isometry class of the Banach space $\mathcal{C}(K)$. As a byproduct, we also determine the precise Borel complexity of the homeomorphism class of a fixed countable compact space $K$, improving earlier results of Cenzer and Mauldin. The above results provide concrete and natural examples of sets with arbitrarily high, still exactly determined, Borel complexity.
